_comment: This project has no application server — build_dashboard.py is a one-shot generator that writes a single self-contained dashboard/index.html. The entry below is a plain static file server over that output, which is the closest thing to a dev server here and renders the page properly (a file:// URL opens as a static snapshot instead). Each start rebuilds first, so the preview can never show a stale build.

configurations.name: CCS Dashboard
runtimeArgs: python3 scripts/build_dashboard.py && exec python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory dashboard
